The most interesting take away for me was:

Optimization is something we should have worried about since day one. ...we’ve kept optimizing the game ever since we launched. The game is way more optimized and smooth today than compared to launch day but sadly, first impressions persist.

And that is why I think going early access (or even allowing micro-backers early access) is just a terrible idea. If Goat Simulator, a game that grew incredibly rapidly and almost exclusively from word of mouth in large part due to its wonkiness still regards early first impressions as meaningfully problematic then imagine your game that probably won't have an army of hundreds of thousands of people talking about it.
